newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Nykredit, BG Bank, Topdanmark end pact.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Nykredit, BG Bank, Topdanmark end pact.

text.p: Denmark's Nykredit, BG Bank and Topdanmark said on Friday that they were ending a strategic alliance but would maintain collaboration in some fields.
"BG Bank and Nykredit have agreed that recent months' consideration of establishing closer co-operation, possibly a merger, cannot be effected," a joint statement said.
"As a result BG Bank, Nykredit and Topdanmark have agreed to dissolve the existing strategic alliance."
It added that BG Bank would take over from mortgage lender Nykredit a shareholding of just under five percent in insurer Topdanmark, raising its stake to 15 percent.
Topdanmark would buy from Nykredit just under five percent in BG Bank, raising its holding to 10 percent.
BG Bank is to buy back from Nykredit about seven percent of its own shares.
Prior to the announcment Nykredit had a 15 percent stake in BG Bank and 14 percent of Topdanmark, while BG Bank held 10 percent of Topdanmark, which had a five percent stake in the bank.
The announcement had no immediate effect on the share prices of BG Bank or Topdanmark. Nykredit is unlisted.

The statement said that the existing three-way sales and marketing alliance would be replaced by a similar agreement between BG Bank and Topdanmark, while there would be normal co-operation between the three on the sale of of mortgages and insurance products.
The activities of mortgage trading company Pantebrevsselskabet would be unchanged and it would remain jointly owned by BG Bank and Nykredit.
The announcment followed a late-night meeting of Nykredit's board where, according to a newspaper report, directors rejected plans by chief executive to strengthen the alliance.
